01

“And We will proceed to whatever deed they did”

Two explanations transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī and ʿAlī (Q 25:23).

731
Explanation from Sufyān No. 731: 1: 12

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
731: 1:12. Sufyan, on His words
"And We will proceed to whatever deed they did": He said, We turned to whatever good deed they had done and did not accept it from them (verse 23).
العربية
731: 1: 12 سفيان فِي قَوْلِهِ وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عملوا من عمل قَالَ عَمِدْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَمْ نقبل منهم (الآية 23) .
Edition record 371465 · p. 226Link to report ↗
732
Explanation from ʿAlī No. 732: 2: 5

ʿAlī

English
Transmission wording
732: 2:5. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali, on His words
"scattered dust": He said, the ray of light that comes in through the window (verse 23).
العربية
732: 2: 5 سفيان عن أبي اسحق عن الحرث عَنْ عَلِيّ فِي قَوْلِهِ هَبَاءً منثورا قَالَ الشُّعَاعُ الَّذِي يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الكوة (الآية 23) .
Edition record 371465 · p. 226Link to report ↗
02

“The day will not reach midday before the people of Paradise and the…”

An explanation transmitted from Abū ʿUbayda (Q 25:24).

733
Explanation from Abū ʿUbayda No. 733: 3: 1

Abū ʿUbayda

English
Transmission wording
733: 3:1. Sufyan, from Maysara ibn Habib al-Nahdi, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Abu Ubayda, who said:
Abd Allah ibn Masud said, "The day will not reach midday before the people of Paradise and the people of the Fire take their midday rest." Then he recited "The companions of Paradise, that day, are better in abode and finer in resting place," and then recited "Then indeed their return is to the Hellfire" (verse 24).
العربية
733: 3: 1 سفيان عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ النَّهْدِيِّ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ لَا يَنْتَصِفُ النَّهَارُ حَتَّى يَقِيلَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ ثُمّ قَرَأَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مقيلا ثُمَّ قَرَأَ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لإِلَى الجحيم (الآية 24) .
Edition record 371465 · p. 226Link to report ↗
03

“Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shadow?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:45).

734
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 734: 4: 6

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
734: 4:6. Sufyan related to us, from Mansur, from Mujahid, on His words
"Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shadow?": He said, the rising of dawn (verse 45).
العربية
734: 4: 6 حدثنا سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قوله تَرَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظل قال طلوع الفجر (الآية 45) .
Edition record 371466 · p. 227Link to report ↗

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:46).

735
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 735: 5: 9

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
735: 5:9. Sufyan, from Said, from Mujahid, on His words
"then We withdraw it to Ourselves in an easy withdrawal": He said, hidden (verse 46).

05

“those who walk upon the earth humbly”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 25:63).

736
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 736: 6: 7

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
736: 6:7. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on the words of God
"those who walk upon the earth humbly": He said, with dignity and serenity (verse 63).
العربية
736: 6: 7 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الأرض هونا قال بالوقار والسكينة (الآية 63) .
Edition record 371466 · p. 227Link to report ↗
737
Explanation from Sufyān No. 737: 7: 8

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
737: 7:8. Sufyan:
"when the ignorant address them, they say 'Peace'": He said, words of rectitude (verse 63).
العربية
737: 7: 8 سفيان خاطبهم الجاهلون قالوا سلاما قال سدادا (الآية 63) .

English
Transmission wording
738: 8:10. Sufyan:

al-Ḍaḥḥāk

English

08

“an imam for the righteous”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Ṣāliḥ (Q 25:74).

740
Explanation from Abū Ṣāliḥ No. 740: 10: 2

Abū Ṣāliḥ

English
Transmission wording
740: 10:2. Sufyan related to us, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Abu Salih, on His words
"an imam for the righteous": He said, those who follow our guidance take us as a model (verse 74).
العربية
740: 10: 2 حدثنا سفيان عن اسمعيل بن أبي خلد عن أبي صلح في قوله للمتقين إماما قال يقتدا أهل بهدانا (الآية 74) .
Edition record 371467 · p. 228Link to report ↗
09

“My Lord would not care for you were it not for your supplication”

An explanation transmitted from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb (Q 25:77).

741
Explanation from ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb No. 741: 11: 3

ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb

English
Transmission wording
741: 11:3. Sufyan related to us, from Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Yala al-Thaqafi, from Amr ibn Shuayb, on His words
"My Lord would not care for you were it not for your supplication": He said, what would my Lord do with you if I had not called you to Islam and you had not responded to me (verse 77).
العربية
741: 11: 3 حدثنا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْلَى الثَّقَفِيِّ عن عمرو ابن شعيب في قوله ما يعبؤا بكم ربي لولا دعاؤكم قَالَ مَا يَصْنَعُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا أَنِّي دَعَوْتُكُمْ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ فتستجيبون لي. (الآية 77) .
